races.paceDynamic: Station X is the sole confirmed front runner and will likely get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace in this sprint handicap. The major tactical issue is prominent congestion with Sports Coach, Master Of My Fate, Reigning Profit, Mon Na Slieve, and Kinetic Force all wanting to sit handy, creating inevitable traffic problems turning for home when the hold-up horses including Tiriac, Havana Blast, and Blinky come with late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Station X gets easy fractions and kicks clear 1f out without serious pressure
scenarios.body: Station X faces minimal early pace pressure and quickens decisively when the prominent runners get tangled up behind. The hold-up horses can't reel him in despite late momentum.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard chasing Station X and sets it up perfectly for closers
scenarios.body: The five prominent runners jostle for position and go fractionally too quick, playing into the hands of the patient hold-up brigade. Tiriac or Havana Blast sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Winner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy horses finds the perfect trip and avoids the traffic
scenarios.body: Sports Coach or Master Of My Fate secure ideal positions just behind Station X without getting caught in the pack shuffle. They time their challenge perfectly as Station X tires and before the hold-up horses arrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Charge Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If extreme pace pressure creates a complete collapse up front with multiple fallers
scenarios.body: Station X gets pressured into unsustainable fractions by aggressive prominent tactics, causing a domino effect of stopping horses. The race becomes a lottery for whichever hold-up horse gets the clearest run.
